answer.origin: Secondhand: a Motley Fool article by Keithen Drury dated 2026-07-06 relays an unnamed average analyst FY2028 EPS projection and management's hyperscaler spending remarks from Nvidia's last quarterly call. The original analysts and the call transcript are not in the record.
answer.note: A July 6, 2026 third-party Motley Fool article reports that the average analyst projects Nvidia (NVDA) fiscal 2028 EPS (year ending January 2028) at $12.76. Its author calls this conservative but offers no basis beyond a claim that analysts have underprojected Nvidia. The article also attributes to management, on its last quarterly call, an expectation that hyperscaler spending will top $1 trillion in 2027 after a projected $650 billion in 2026, and says analysts expect 82% growth for the rest of the current year and 41% for 2027, without stating which metric those growth rates cover. If the consensus EPS figure holds, it supports a view that the market expects substantial earnings growth into fiscal 2028. The article's $319 value (25x multiple) and $300 target are the author's own valuation view, not company or analyst guidance, so they carry little weight here. The hyperscaler figures inform demand for Nvidia's data-center products as management's relayed view, but they are not confirmed by the record and are not Nvidia's own orders.
limitations: The $12.76 fiscal 2028 EPS figure is an unnamed average analyst projection as relayed by a media author; the number of analysts, the date of the consensus and its inclusion criteria are not disclosed.

The $650 billion (2026) and $1 trillion (2027) hyperscaler spending figures are relayed secondhand from management's last quarterly call; the call date, exact wording and whether these are capex or another measure are not in the record.
The 82% and 41% growth rates are not tied to a stated metric (revenue, EPS or other) or a stated base period, so they cannot be used as exact numeric answers.
The record does not disclose whether the $12.76 consensus has changed since July 6, 2026.
follow_up: Obtain the current FY2028 EPS consensus from a dated, named data provider and compare it with the $12.76 figure.
Check Nvidia's most recent quarterly earnings call transcript for the exact hyperscaler spending statements ($650 billion for 2026, over $1 trillion for 2027) and their definition.
Confirm which metric and base period the 82% (rest of this year) and 41% (2027) growth figures refer to in the cited analyst sources.
